_meta.name: HALOS Demonstration Food Composition Database
_meta.description: Configurable dietary sodium and salt composition reference database for research prototyping and dietary assessment.
_meta.disclaimer: All values in this demonstration dataset are prototype estimates for research simulation and testing. For clinical or real-world research studies, values must be replaced with validated regional Food Composition Tables (e.g., USDA FoodData Central, Sri Lankan Food Composition Tables by MRI).
